key.name: toggle-overlay
key.summary: Open the clipboard overlay

key.name: history-size
key.summary: How many unpinned entries to keep

key.name: capture-images
key.summary: Store images copied to the clipboard

key.name: prefer-text-when-both
key.summary: Prefer text when a copy offers both text and an image
key.description: Rich-text copies from office suites advertise an image/png flavour as well as plain text. With this on, those are stored as text; copies that offer only image flavours (screenshots, "Copy Image") are still stored as images.

key.name: max-image-mb
key.summary: Skip clipboard images larger than this many megabytes

key.name: max-blob-mb
key.summary: Total disk budget for stored images
key.description: Oldest unpinned images are dropped once the images WinClip has stored exceed this. Pinned images, and entries that merely point at your own files, are not counted.

key.name: auto-paste
key.summary: Paste immediately after picking an item
key.description: Synthesises Ctrl+V into the window that had focus, like the Windows clipboard. Turn off to only place the item on the clipboard.

key.name: paste-delay-ms
key.summary: Delay before the synthetic paste

key.name: gif-scan-folders
key.summary: Folders searched for GIFs already on this computer

key.name: gif-scan-depth
key.summary: How many directory levels down to search

key.name: gif-scan-max
key.summary: Stop after finding this many GIFs

key.name: gif-animate
key.summary: Animate GIF previews
key.description: Each playing GIF is captured once into a short loop of thumbnail-sized frames, costing a few megabytes. Turn this off to show a single still frame instead, which is cheaper again.

key.name: gif-paste-format
key.summary: How a GIF is placed on the clipboard
key.description: GNOME publishes one clipboard type per copy, so a GIF has to pick one. "uri" offers the file itself, which chat clients and file managers attach as a working animation; this is the default, since keeping the animation is usually the point. Sandboxed applications may not be able to read the file, in which case nothing is pasted. "png" converts the first frame, which pastes into anything but does not move. "gif" keeps it moving but only works in applications that request image/gif, which is few.

key.name: gif-search-provider
key.summary: Online GIF search service
key.description: Off by default. When set, search terms typed in the GIF tab are sent to the chosen service. Requires your own API key.

key.name: gif-giphy-key
key.summary: Your Giphy API key

key.name: gif-search-limit
key.summary: How many results to request

key.name: gif-search-rating
key.summary: Content filter applied to search results

key.name: skin-tone
key.summary: Emoji skin tone (0 = default)

key.name: panel-width
key.summary: Overlay width in pixels

key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Overlay height in pixels

key.name: last-tab
key.summary: Tab to reopen on

key.name: remember-tab
key.summary: Reopen on the last used tab instead of Clipboard

key.name: emoji-recent
key.summary: Recently used emoji

key.name: emoji-pinned
key.summary: Pinned emoji
